title: Claude Code Concepts Explained
content: Claude is not deterministic. Instead of depending on probabilities, one can guarantee actions by creating hooks. A hook is a script that runs automatically every time Claude does something specific. It has two parts: when it runs and what it runs. For example, if you want the test of your application to run every time Claude finishes a task, you can write that rule in Claude.md and hope Claude remembers. Most of the time it will. Alternatively, you can create a hook. When Claude finishes a task, it will run the script containing your tests every time with no exceptions. MCP, Model Context Protocol, is an open standard for connecting AI tools to external services. This allows one to use Claude code with tools like GitHub, Notion, Slack, and more.
